normalized_key: web_search|query=augmented benchmark dataset dragin dynamic four generation intensive knowledge retrieval
result:
Summary: The DRAGIN framework evaluates across four knowledge-intensive generation datasets: 2WikiMultihopQA, HotpotQA (multi-hop question answering), StrategyQA (commonsense reasoning), and IIRC (reading comprehension). The researchers conducted comprehensive experiments to demonstrate DRAGIN's superior performance on all tasks, showing its effectiveness in dynamically retrieving information based on the LLM's real-time information needs during the text generation process.
